SERVICE.label: Start the Polyseat/Incus service automatically when the array starts
SERVICE.title: Start at array start

DATA_DIR.label: Data directory on a pool or array disk (Incus state, seats, games). Never deleted by the plugin.
DATA_DIR.title: Data directory

ACCEPT_NO_LSM.label: Accept running containers without AppArmor/SELinux when the host has one the bundle cannot use
ACCEPT_NO_LSM.title: Accept missing LSM

HEALTH_TIMEOUT.label: Seconds to wait for the daemon to become healthy
HEALTH_TIMEOUT.title: Health timeout (s)

SUBID_START.label: First subordinate UID/GID reserved for containers
SUBID_START.title: Subordinate ID start

SUBID_COUNT.label: Number of subordinate UIDs/GIDs reserved for containers
SUBID_COUNT.title: Subordinate ID count

PLAY_CPU_PERCENT.label: Share of the whole host's CPU that a play session may use (0 = unlimited). Applies to the next play session.
PLAY_CPU_PERCENT.title: Play CPU limit (%)

PLAY_MEMORY_MB.label: Memory a play session may use, in MB (0 = unlimited). The stop when the host itself runs low on memory stays. Applies to the next play session.
PLAY_MEMORY_MB.title: Play memory limit (MB)

LIBRARY_PATH.label: Game library: the mount point of its own ZFS dataset, with a quota, owned by root, under /mnt. Checked when a play session starts.
LIBRARY_PATH.title: Game library path
